title: Sundial: A Family of Highly Capable Time Series Foundation Models

layout.note: Two stacked bands: the upper one holds a domain icon strip above two tinted panels (native vs foreign tokenization); the lower one holds three tinted design columns with the same skeleton, divided by dashed lines.

lesson: Draw competing designs as columns with one shared skeleton so that only the differing parts (token colour, loss box, background tint) change, give each design axis its own colour channel with a legend in the section heading, and mark the proposed column with a red title.
